title: Seacrest Beach "Ocean Pearl" 7999 E Co Hwy 30A
h1: Seacrest Beach "Ocean Pearl" 7999 E Co Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Amazing Gulf views- Beach access is located just across the street and is one of the least crowded beaches on 30A- Conveniently located a mile from Alys Beach and The Hub- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Private pool *Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day*- Gourmet chef's kitchen- Outdoor kitchen- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 7 adult bikes- Peloton- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout- 2 sets of complimentary backpack beach chairs( 4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) are available onsite for the 2026 yearDetails: Coastal luxury reigns at Ocean Pearl, an exquisite 7-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom Seacrest Beach retreat that sleeps 20—2 minutes from the Gulf’s emerald waters. Unwind in style in the lush backyard, complete with a private pool and outdoor kitchen, or savor time with friends and family in the sprawling game room. With ample amenities and nearby restaurants and dining at The Big Chill, this opulent 3-level property is the ultimate 30A escape.Indoor and outdoor living beautifully merge on the first floor, where a sprawling game room—complete with a ping-pong table, oversized couch, TV, wet bar, and Xbox—leads the way to the resort-inspired backyard. Unwind on the poolside loungers while listening to the cascading waterfall, play cornhole, or sip cocktails at the outdoor kitchen’s bar. At bedtime, retire to the charming bunk room with 3 twin-over-twin bunks. A laundry room on this level makes it easy to refresh beach towels, and an in-home elevator adds convenience.Nearly 360-degree Gulf views provide a breathtaking backdrop in the sophisticated second-level great room, adorned with a coffered ceiling and shiplap walls for an elegant and relaxing setting. Watch movies with loved ones on the 2 matching sofas in the living area, or converse in the intimate lounge space. Fully equipped with side-by-side commercial refrigerators, a Wolf gas stove, and a 3-stool breakfast bar, the gourmet kitchen provides everything needed for delectable home-cooked meals shared at the 8-seat dining table. Drink in the sunset from the adjacent covered balcony before retiring to the 2 guest bedrooms off the great room, each featuring a king-sized bed.The third-floor bonus room was designed for carefree days, featuring a TV, couch, armchairs, and a hanging chair. Enjoy a splendid night’s rest in the primary bedroom, boasting a plush king bed and a spacious balcony. The remaining sleeping accommodations include 1 bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds, and 2 guest bedrooms featuring king beds—1 accessible through the bunk room. This floor also has a washer and dryer.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 20):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Common Bathroom: Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only, Private Balcony Access- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
